48. It is noted that the quotation and the invoice stated:

“消防署則定每次只可關閉 14 日，所以要每 14 日同消防署申請延期，貴司預計停 1 年”

49. The reference to “1 year” reflected my understanding that the entire project at Wang Fuk Court would span approximately one year. It referred to the project as a whole, rather than any individual SDN for any particular building. As the works for different buildings would take place at different times, which may or may not overlap, I used “1 year” as a general reference to avoid unnecessary complication.

50. The reference to “1 year” was for my own record and general understanding. I did not expect nor intend that any SDN would remain valid for one year.

51. This understanding is consistent with the actual SDN applications I made, which were submitted between April 2025 and September 2025 (see para. 16 of 1st Witness Statement).

52. It is our practice to charge a fixed fee for SDN services on a project basis, regardless of the duration of the SDN, whether it lasts for weeks or months. An example of this practice can be seen in the CWB Project. A fee of HKD 3,000 was quoted (via phone) for the entire project, irrespective of its duration. In the end, that project lasted for approximately 8 weeks and the fee remained unchanged (see the invoice at Annexure-5).

Site Visit  
53. In April 2025, after the fire extinguishers had been delivered to PC&E, Mr. Cheung informed me over the telephone that it would not be necessary to attend the site to carry out any inspection or works, and the building management of Wang Fuk Court had indicated that they would carry out those works by themselves.
